name: memory
description: Durable user memory — a numbered list of facts kept in view across conversations. Load to remember, revise or forget things about the user or your standing task.

content.inline:
## Memory
One tool, dispatched by `command`:
- `{command: "remember", text}` appends a new item.
- `{command: "update", n, text}` replaces item n; `{command: "forget", n}` removes it. Numbers are the 1-based positions shown in the rendered list — the number you see is the number you edit.
- `{command: "recall"}` renders the numbered list (rarely needed — operators usually pin it into context via a config.context assemble entry, so it is already in view).

Conventions:
- Keep items short, factual, one fact per item. Revise rather than duplicate.
- The list lives at `w/memory` by default (`path` overrides); every edit rewrites the whole list, so removals are durable.
- Memory is per-user: acting as a user, you maintain THEIR memory.
